referenceScope: Pinned native/default content composition; original static Figma variants remain in stories. Source wrapper APIs and optional native render semantics are described in CEM/README.

contractCases.expected: Root is role=presentation and wraps an internally created Viewport, vertical ScrollBar and Corner. Scrollbar/Corner are aria-hidden. Viewport is tabindex=0 only while at least one axis overflows, otherwise -1. Native scrolling drives viewport position, edge and thumb geometry. Root props are not Viewport props; the wrapper exports no Viewport and does not promise forwarding onScroll or aria-label to it. External sizing must make the viewport constrained. ScrollBar orientation defaults vertical; horizontal is explicitly composed. It does not auto-follow messages or preserve chat anchors; MessageScroller owns that behavior.

This reference uses an outer labelled section because the wrapper Root remains presentational. Native keyboard/wheel/touch scrolling and focusable descendants remain available. Browser scroll position is internal viewport state, not an invented Root value/onValueChange API.

The region has a caller-supplied real heading and all scrollable content remains native text/list/link. The visual scrollbar is aria-hidden; it is not a second fake adjustable widget. Overflow must not be the only indication that more content exists.
